conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on income and broad market exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns.

balanced.read: This plan targets ~2.5% monthly return with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding quality names and broad index exposure, aiming for growth with managed risk.

aggressive.read: This plan targets ~4% monthly return by aggressively concentrating in high-conviction names and adding leverage. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risks associated with leveraged ETF decay.

Trim SPY to 10% and sell growth-oriented ETFs (QQQ, SMH).

income.read: This plan targets ~1% monthly return by focusing on income-generating assets like QQQI and DRIP. It minimizes leverage and growth-oriented holdings to prioritize capital preservation and steady distributions, accepting lower growth potential.
